001package com.ghostchu.quickshop.api.event.economy;
002
003import com.ghostchu.quickshop.api.event.AbstractQSEvent;
004import com.ghostchu.quickshop.api.inventory.InventoryWrapper;
005import com.ghostchu.quickshop.api.obj.QUser;
006import com.ghostchu.quickshop.api.shop.Shop;
007import org.jetbrains.annotations.NotNull;
008
009import java.math.BigDecimal;
010import java.util.UUID;
011
012/**
013 * Calling when success purchase in shop
014 */
015public class ShopSuccessPurchaseEvent extends AbstractQSEvent {
016
017  private final ShopTransactionContext context;
018  private final double tax;
019
020  /**
021   * Builds a new shop purchase event Will called when purchase ended
022   *
023   * @param shop               The shop bought from
024   * @param purchaser          The player buying, may offline if purchase by plugin
025   * @param purchaserInventory The purchaseing target inventory, *MAY NOT A PLAYER INVENTORY IF
026   *                           PLUGIN PURCHASE THIS*
027   * @param amount             The amount they're buying
028   * @param tax                The tax in this purchase
029   * @param total              The money in this purchase
030   */
031  public ShopSuccessPurchaseEvent(
032          @NotNull final Shop shop, @NotNull final QUser purchaser, @NotNull final InventoryWrapper purchaserInventory, final int amount, final double total, final double tax) {
033
034    this(new ShopTransactionContext(
035            shop,
036            purchaser,
037            purchaserInventory,
038            ShopTransactionDirection.fromShopType(shop.getShopType()),
039            amount,
040            BigDecimal.valueOf(shop.getPrice()),
041            BigDecimal.valueOf(total)), tax);
042  }
043
044  /**
045   * Builds a success event around the context from the corresponding pre-transaction event.
046   *
047   * @param context the shared transaction context
048   * @param tax     the tax charged by the transaction
049   */
050  public ShopSuccessPurchaseEvent(@NotNull final ShopTransactionContext context, final double tax) {
051
052    this.context = context;
053    this.tax = tax;
054  }
055
056  /**
057   * Gets the item stack amounts
058   *
059   * @return Item stack amounts
060   */
061  public int getAmount() {
062
063    return context.getItemAmount();
064  }
065
066  /**
067   * @return the number of configured shop units traded
068   */
069  public int getTradeCount() {
070
071    return context.getTradeCount();
072  }
073
074  /**
075   * The total money changes in this purchase. Calculate tax, if you want get total without tax,
076   * please use getBalanceWithoutTax()
077   *
078   * @return the total money with calculate tax
079   */
080  public double getBalance() {
081
082    return context.getTotalPrice().doubleValue() - tax;
083  }
084
085  /**
086   * The total money changes in this purchase. No calculate tax, if you want get total with tax,
087   * please use getBalance()
088   *
089   * @return the total money without calculate tax
090   */
091  public double getBalanceWithoutTax() {
092
093    return context.getTotalPrice().doubleValue();
094  }
095
096  /**
097   * Gets the effective total price before tax without converting it to a double.
098   *
099   * @return the effective total price
100   */
101  public @NotNull BigDecimal getTotalPrice() {
102
103    return context.getTotalPrice();
104  }
105
106
107  /**
108   * Gets the purchaser, that maybe is a online/offline/virtual player.
109   *
110   * @return The purchaser uuid
111   */
112  public @NotNull QUser getPurchaser() {
113
114    return context.getTrader();
115  }
116
117  /**
118   * Gets the inventory of purchaser (the item will put to)
119   *
120   * @return The inventory
121   */
122  public @NotNull InventoryWrapper getPurchaserInventory() {
123
124    return context.getTraderInventory();
125  }
126
127  /**
128   * Gets the shop
129   *
130   * @return the shop
131   */
132  public @NotNull Shop getShop() {
133
134    return context.getShop();
135  }
136
137  /**
138   * Gets the tax in this purchase
139   *
140   * @return The tax
141   */
142  public double getTax() {
143
144    return this.tax;
145  }
146
147  /**
148   * @return the shared transaction context
149   */
150  public @NotNull ShopTransactionContext getContext() {
151
152    return context;
153  }
154
155  /**
156   * @return the id shared by all lifecycle events for this transaction attempt
157   */
158  public @NotNull UUID getTransactionId() {
159
160    return context.getTransactionId();
161  }
162}
